format: Perl (Perl script with embedded assembly for x86_64 with AVX2 instructions)
description: This file contains Perl code that generates optimized assembly routines for cryptographic operations, specifically AVX2-accelerated modular squaring and multiplication for 1024-bit operands, including functions for reduction, normalization, scattering, and gathering of data. It also includes SEH handler code for Windows exception handling.

methods.name: rsaz_1024_sqr_avx2
methods.description: Assembly routine for 1024-bit modular squaring optimized with AVX2 instructions.

methods.name: rsaz_1024_red2norm_avx2
methods.description: Assembly routine to convert 1024-bit reduction result to normalized form.

methods.name: rsaz_1024_norm2red_avx2
methods.description: Assembly routine to convert normalized data to reduction form.

methods.name: rsaz_1024_scatter5_avx2
methods.description: Assembly routine to scatter data into a specific permutation pattern for 1024-bit data.

methods.name: rsaz_1024_gather5_avx2
methods.description: Assembly routine to gather data from a permutation pattern into a contiguous form for 1024-bit data.
